how_to_apply: Open the institute website, www.iiitn.ac.in, and follow the link to the recruitment portal.
Fill in the online application form for the post.
Upload the supporting documents. T&P officer applicants must include their experience documents signed by the Competent Authority.
Submit before 5:00 PM on 19 November 2026, when the portal closes. You do not need to send a hard copy.

For the interview, bring: your original documents and one complete set of self-attested photocopies of the online application and supporting documents. Changes to the advertisement are posted only on the institute website. Canvassing in any form leads to disqualification, and false information leads to cancellation at any stage.

content_sections.heading: About IIIT Nagpur
content_sections.text: IIIT Nagpur is one of the 20 Indian Institutes of Information Technology set up under the Ministry of Education's Public-Private Partnership Scheme. Under the IIIT (PPP) Act, 2017, it has been declared an Institution of National Importance. It offers undergraduate and PhD programmes in CSE, ECE, Basic Sciences, AI & ML, Data Science & Analytics, HCI & Gaming Technology and IoT. The campus is about 25 km from Nagpur city, at Survey No. 140,141/1, Behind Br. Sheshrao Wankhade Shetkari Sahkari Soot Girni, Village Waranga, PO Dongargaon (Butibori), District Nagpur – 441108 (Maharashtra).

content_sections.heading: Duties of Each Post
content_sections.text: Both officers assist the Registrar or the Faculty In-Charge (T&P), mainly with student placements and internships. The work covers compiling and analysing student data, dealing with industry, and handling pre-placement procedures, aptitude tests, group discussions, technical and HR interviews, and institute-industry interaction. They also carry out administrative tasks for other sections when required. Both report to the Registrar or as the Competent Authority advises. The counsellor counsels students, mostly aged 18 to 28, as well as adults over 28. The role includes building a counselling programme for the institute, working with volunteer agencies and hospitals, and running workshops, talks and group discussions. The counsellor keeps sessions confidential but must report any extreme case that needs the institution or the family to step in. They also keep a database on the mental well-being of students and employees. The counsellor reports to the Associate Dean (Student Welfare), the Registrar or as the Competent Authority advises. This officer looks after lab and equipment maintenance, IT, networking and email handling. The required knowledge covers system maintenance and troubleshooting, OS and driver installation, server maintenance, Wi-Fi and wired/wireless LAN, routing, and basic programming in Python, Java, C++ and C. The officer reports to the HoD or the Registrar. This officer handles lab work and equipment, IT, networking and email. The required knowledge covers circuit laws, AC fundamentals, sensors and transducers, SMPS and UPS electronics, analog and digital circuits, op amps, the 555 timer, signals and systems, control systems, DSO and PCB rework. It also covers tools such as PSpice, Cadence, MATLAB and network simulators, and newer technology such as antennas, SDR kits, cognitive radio and wireless communication. Candidates with experience in computer networking, LAN/WAN, and maintaining printers and routers will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted first. The institute may set norms higher than the minimum, and meeting the qualifications alone does not guarantee an interview call. Depending on the number of applications, the institute may hold a written test, interviews or both. Interviews will be held offline. Eligible candidates will be told the dates. Original documents are verified at the interview. A candidate whose documents do not meet the criteria, or who does not bring originals, will not be allowed to take the interview. The institute may offer a lower post to a candidate it finds suitable. No TA/DA or lodging and boarding is paid for attending the interview. Paid guest-house accommodation is offered on a first-come basis, subject to availability. Details are on the institute website.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The positions are purely temporary and contractual, for 11 months. Extensions may follow under institute policy, depending on performance. Appointments are made through a third-party manpower supply service agency and give no right or preference to appointment on IIIT Nagpur's own rolls. The Student Counsellor attends the institute Monday to Saturday, 09:30 AM to 6 PM, or as the competent authority decides. The counsellor must be available for emergencies during holidays and odd hours, and must counsel online during a lockdown or curfew. The selected candidates will get joining details by email through the third party.

faq.question: Q1. What is the salary of a Junior Technical Officer at IIIT Nagpur?
faq.answer: Junior Technical Officers in both the CSE and ECE streams get Rs. 30,000 a month, consolidated.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the Junior Technical Officer posts?
faq.answer: Not more than 30 years, counted as on the closing date of 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can an IT graduate apply for Junior Technical Officer (CSE)?
faq.answer: Yes. The post accepts B.Tech/B.E in Computer Science & Engineering or Information Technology.

faq.question: Q4. How much T&P experience does the Senior Officer post need?
faq.answer: At least five years of Training & Placement work experience, along with graduation in any discipline. The Officer post needs two years.

faq.question: Q5. Is a psychology degree enough for the Student Counsellor post?
faq.answer: B.A/B.Sc. (Psychology) works only with a Diploma in Counselling and three years of experience counselling students. With M.A/M.Sc. (Psychology), two years of experience is enough.

faq.question: Q6. Are the Student Counsellor posts reserved by gender?
faq.answer: Yes. Of the two posts, one is for a male candidate and one for a female candidate.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job at IIIT Nagpur?
faq.answer: No. It is an 11-month contract through a third-party manpower agency, and it gives no claim to a post on IIIT Nagpur's own rolls.

faq.question: Q8. Do I need to post a hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: No. You apply online only. Bring originals and self-attested photocopies to the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Will the interview be online?
faq.answer: No. Interviews will be held offline, and no TA/DA is paid for attending.
